violations.text: Raw animal foods (such as meats) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as vegetables and cooked food) in the walk-in refrigerator. Employee relocated raw foods to bottom shelf and ready to eat foods to top shelf. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Proper storage guidance document provided and reviewed at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was (25) parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment shall sanitize in 3-bay sink until dishwasher is serviced and in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

Working containers of (dry ingredients) are not labeled with the common name of the food located in kitchen. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026
3 door cooler and 2 door refrigerator gaskets located in the (kitchen) area was not in good repair. PIC has a serviced order placed. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (chlorine) sanitizing solution for the (3-bay sink). New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the (racks) in 3-door cooler, prep area and fan located in kitchen have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026

Several TCS foods were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2024
Refrigerator (produce) door gaskets were observed torn and in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2024
The door to the (service area) toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2024
The floor in the kitchen area is in poor repair, observed missing tile. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2024
The ceiling tiles in the ware washing area is in poor repair, observed peeling and cracked. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/30/2024
